meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Guides a refactor, cleanup, or restructure with the right decomposition. Use when the user asks to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把混乱的代码拆解重组，理清结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头代码越改越乱，想在不改行为的前提下梳理结构
copy.tagline_en: Break messy code apart and rebuild it into clear structure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has grown messy and you want to reorganize it without changing behavior

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会走 /refactor 流程:先跟你确认重构目标,再梳理代码依赖、评估测试覆盖,然后逐步改动,每步跑测试和类型检查,最后给出改动清单和修改文件。
howto.when: 当你要求重构、简化、抽取代码等操作时触发;目标、范围或期望结果不清楚时,它会先反问确认再动手。

say.text: 把校验逻辑抽到单独的模块
say.note: 它会先确认目标再开始分析

howto.what_en: After install, Claude follows the /refactor flow: it first confirms the refactor goal with you, maps code dependencies and test coverage, then changes code step by step, running tests and type checks after each step, and ends with a change summary and modified files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code. If the target, scope, or desired outcome is unclear, it asks a clarifying question before starting.

say_en.text: Extract the validation logic into its own module
say_en.note: It confirms the goal before analyzing
Broader changes allowed, needs adequate test coverage
